name: University of St Andrews
summary: About 150 degrees in the Scottish town of St Andrews, most over four years; IB offers run 36–38, and overseas-fee students can apply direct.

ib.text: 36 (HL 6,5,5) to 38 (HL 6,6,6 plus SL 6,6,6), depending on the degree. Where A-level Maths is required, HL Maths AA or AI is accepted. Medicine asks 38 with HL Chemistry.

apply.via: UCAS, Common App or direct application

Deadline for most other courses (UCAS or direct application)

programmes.name: International Relations
programmes.about: The origins of war and peace, foreign policy, trade, terrorism, human rights and international law. You take two other subjects alongside it in year one, then specialise in years three and four, ending in a 12,000-word dissertation. The MA here is the equivalent of a BA.
programmes.ib: 38 points with HL 6,6,6 is the standard offer; the minimum is 36 with HL 6,5,5. No subject is required.
programmes.selectionNote: Offers can be higher or lower than the published grades; your personal statement and reference are read as well. No test or interview is listed.

flagshipSource.title: International Relations MA (Hons): run by the School of International Relations, from war and peace to international law

programmes.name: Astrophysics
programmes.about: The Universe from extrasolar planets and black holes to galaxy clusters, about half core physics and maths and half astrophysics. You model systems and analyse large data sets, can use telescopes at the University Observatory, and finish with a major project.
programmes.ib: 38 points with HL 6,6,6, including HL 6 in Maths and Physics; the minimum is 36 with HL 6,5,5 and HL 5 in both.
programmes.selectionNote: No test or interview is listed. Offers can be higher or lower than the published grades; the personal statement and reference are read too.

flagshipSource.title: Astrophysics BSc (Hons): half physics and maths, half astrophysics, with University Observatory telescopes

programmes.name: Medicine BSc (Hons) A100
programmes.about: A six-year route: three years in St Andrews building science and clinical skills for a BSc, then three years at a partner medical school for an MBChB or MBBS. Students classed as overseas for fees complete their training at the University of Manchester.
programmes.ib: 38 points with HL 6,6,6 plus SL 6,6,6, including HL Chemistry and one of HL Biology, Maths or Physics.
programmes.selectionNote: Academic record, reference and medical work experience first; the UCAT ranks applicants for about 650 interviews (four mini interviews, online for most non-UK applicants in 2026).

flagshipSource.title: Medicine A100: three years at St Andrews for a BSc, then three at a partner medical school

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: MA degrees: 38 points (HL 6,6,6) is the standard offer, 36 (HL 6,5,5) the minimum; each degree page names any subjects.

faculties.name: Faculty of Divinity
faculties.line: Offers the BD, an MA or an MTheol; you apply to a degree, and St Andrews offers run from 36 (HL 6,5,5) to 38 (HL 6,6,6).

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: BSc and integrated master's degrees; physical sciences want HL 6 in Maths and Physics, e.g. Astrophysics. Some subjects also run in Arts.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medicine
faculties.line: Medicine closes 15 October: UCAT ranks applicants for interviews; 38 points with HL Chemistry and one more science.

notes: An EU citizen living in the EU usually has Overseas fee status: £33,250 a year in Arts, Divinity or Science for 2026-27, and 2027-28 fees were not yet out.
Overseas-fee students may apply direct (£50 fee) or through the Common App instead of UCAS, but it still counts as one of your five UK choices.
Degrees usually take four years, with broad first years; in Arts the degree is called an MA, which equals a BA elsewhere, not a master’s.
